market_context: Equities face heavy selling pressure as the 10-year Treasury yield surged to 5.10% following stronger-than-expected core retail sales and hawkish comments from St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem. The VIX has spiked 13.8% to 26.07 amid broad risk-off positioning and de-risking ahead of Nvidia's high-stakes Q3 earnings release after the bell. While mega-cap tech staged a modest midday rebound off session lows, high borrowing costs and pre-earnings hedging are expected to cap upside into the 4:00 PM ET close.

predictions.reasoning: SPY has bounced from its intraday low of $727.00 to $730.89, but overhead resistance remains formidable with the 10-year yield holding at 5.10%. With the VIX elevated above 26, institutional de-risking into the final hour ahead of Nvidia's earnings report is likely to fade this midday bounce. Expect selling pressure on the market-on-close imbalance to pull the ETF back toward $729.10.

The Nasdaq-100 tracker rebounded nearly eight points off its morning trough of $646.65, but tech sentiment remains fragile amid leadership uncertainty across AI heavyweights and surging discount rates. Pre-earnings hedging against an implied ±7.1% swing in NVDA will restrict late-day buyers. QQQ is projected to drift back down toward $651.80 before the closing bell.

The Dow ETF is today's worst-performing major index, down 1.62% and trading right near its intraday low of $506.45. Severe post-earnings declines in components like Home Depot and UnitedHealth have sapped buying interest across industrial and healthcare blue chips. Without tech-style dip buyers supporting the price-weighted index, DIA should close near session lows at $505.90.

NVDA has drifted back to $153.71 after hitting a low of $150.36, as traders position ahead of its first post-close earnings report under interim CEO Colette Kress. Options markets are pricing significant binary volatility, incentivizing risk-averse funds to trim long exposure in the final trading hour rather than hold through the print. This pre-close distribution should guide shares lower toward $152.40 by 4:00 PM ET.
